response.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT telescope_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS combined_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those represented by at least one row in telescopes; each telescope row counts once, and shares are proportions of all telescope rows.
